top_signals.title: Treasuries, Asian Bonds Extend Losses; Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Treasuries extended recent declines and Asian bonds followed as concerns over US government spending and a flood of long-dated debt weighed on sentiment, while higher oil prices stoked fears of inflation. Stocks and equity futures both fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bond Slump Sends Long-Term Borrowing Costs to Highest in Decades
top_signals.summary: Longer-maturity bonds are at the epicenter of investor angst about everything from inflation to the debt-laden artificial-intelligence boom — and governments are paying the price.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
